tools.name: get_estate_overview
tools.description: Every tower with its bundle, lifecycle state, open work, items awaiting approval, SLA attainment against target and glidepath against contract. Start here when a question is about the service as a whole or you do not yet know which tower it concerns.

tools.name: get_brief
tools.description: What happened since the user's last session and what is waiting on them: items closed and closed unaided, hours displaced, incidents avoided, proposals raised, and the ranked asks (approvals, verifications, decisions, obligations, proposals), marked as the user's or another owner's.

tools.name: get_work_queue
tools.description: Open work items (incidents, requests, problems, changes, findings) with priority, state, SLA consumed and breach probability, most at risk first. Optionally narrowed to a tower, a priority or a state.

tools.name: get_work_item
tools.description: One work item by id or reference: its service, demand class, affected components, SLA clock, autonomy decision and timeline.

id.description: Work item id (wo_…) or its reference (INC…, RITM…)

tools.name: get_approvals
tools.description: Plans held at a human gate, ordered by SLA consumed: the action classes, blast radius, agent grades, the gate's approver role and timeout.

tools.name: get_sla
tools.description: Service levels and experience levels with month-to-date attainment against target, breaches, headroom and the credit bands at stake. Optionally for one tower.

tools.name: get_data_estate
tools.description: The data estate register: sources, pipelines, datasets, semantic models and reports, with each item's own state against its contract, what reaches it from upstream, contract enforcement, classification, stewardship and lineage gaps. Breaches carry the reports they make wrong and the recovery path.

tools.name: get_data_item
tools.description: One data item by id or name: contract and its checks, freshness, runs, classification, steward, holds, lineage upstream and everything it feeds.

id.description: Data item id (e.g. ds_engagement_gold) or its name

tools.name: get_privacy_requests
tools.description: Access, erasure and retrieval requests against the statutory clock, with search gaps, process breaches, holds and retention. Give an id for one request's store-by-store search and actions.

tools.name: get_releases
tools.description: Vendor and internal releases across applications and the data estate: window, state, regression gate, blocking and informing flags, and change freezes.

tools.name: get_tech_debt
tools.description: The technical debt register with interest measured from the demand ledger, estimates, payback, flags, and the quarterly remediation recommendation within declared capacity.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Service functions of a contract bundle and the agents that own or only assist each, derived from agent charters.

bundle.description: Bundle id, e.g. B3 or B4

tools.name: run_agent
tools.description: Hand an operational intent to the agent runtime: an agent is routed, retrieves context, reasons, and if the estate must change proposes a plan that the Autonomy Policy Engine decides — advise, a human gate, supervised or autonomous. Use for diagnosing a live problem in depth or remediating one. The run narrates itself and returns its finding, mode and outcome.
tools.describe: Hand “{intent}” to the agent runtime. If it proposes a change, the policy engine decides whether it runs.

intent.description: The intent in the operator's words

tools.name: approve_gate
tools.description: Approve a plan held at a human gate. The approval is sealed to the evidence chain under the user's name.

tools.name: reject_gate
tools.description: Reject a plan held at a human gate, with the reason. The work returns to the human queue and the disagreement is scored against the agent.
